description.value: Unique Bakery is a handcrafted artisan bakery specializing in naturally fermented bread, bagels, pretzels, and toast made from locally sourced ingredients. The bakery emphasizes a slow, traditional fermentation process and low-sugar, low-fat recipes. Products can be ordered online for pickup or through partner retail locations in Richmond and Burnaby.

OSM coordinates (49.2645974, -123.00799) place the node in Burnaby, not Richmond or North Vancouver, suggesting the OSM record may be pinned to a partner pickup location rather than the actual bakery.
